building_identity: Franklin Levering Cary Quadrangle (East), Purdue building code CQE, source FID 639

sources.geometry_method: Use returned WGS84 polygon; project each vertex with the repository-documented Purdue campus conversion; simplify collinear/noisy vertices with 0.12 m tolerance while retaining at least 9 vertices.
limitations: The source attributes Shape__Area and Shape__Length do not match area and perimeter measured from the returned polygon; the returned geometry is used for plan shape.
The source does not document units for Extrution=48. The builder interprets it as feet (14.63 m) only as a tentative overall height estimate.
GIS NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO both report 5, while the specific historical description reports 3 stories plus basement. The model shows three above-grade window levels and records this conflict.

sources.use: Confirms long north-south roof mass and visible roof interruptions; does not establish facade details or storey height.

sources.role: building-specific historic identity and architectural description
sources.use: Purdue Archives identifies the East building as the first Cary Quadrangle building; describes a 42 by 269 ft historic envelope, brick, stone, reinforced concrete, three stories plus basement, Tudor Gothic, cornerstone dated 1927-11-05 and opening in 1928.
sources.capture_note: Direct archival page was blocked to automated retrieval; these facts were taken from the Purdue Archives search-index result.

sources.use: Purdue Archives collection summary states Cary Hall East opened September 1929 and the outer halls, including East, were renovated during 2000-2006.
sources.capture_note: Direct archival page was blocked to automated retrieval; this is contextual evidence only.

sources.role: current Purdue Housing context and general architectural imagery
sources.use: Current housing page describes Cary Quadrangle and renovation context. The hero depicts Cary generally and is not labeled as a view of the East building; it is not used as direct East facade proof.
General 1950s Cary Quadrangle view; it is not labeled as CQE and therefore informs only broad brick/stone/Tudor-Gothic interpretation, not exact facade geometry.

model_interpretations: The official footprint is the strongest building-specific geometric source.

Three visible window rows follow the specific historic description; floor spacing, window counts, window proportions, stone courses, pilasters, entrance placement, and the pointed-arch treatment are schematic interpretations.
The long gable roof and ten small dormer-like forms are approximated from the orthophoto. The source imagery does not resolve dormer shape or establish that all apparent roof protrusions are dormers.
No measured facade elevations or verified height source were found. Overall height 14.63 m is a feet-to-meters interpretation of the GIS Extrution field and remains unverified.
coordinate_contract: Campus world coordinates, meters, X east, Y north, Z up; identity object transforms.
